scope.purpose: One-shot gold transfer reveal from real fish focus to the species title below the Result Hero.

authority_precedence: Recognition Visual Fidelity V1.2 remains authoritative for the three Processing states and existing RESOLVE semantics.
Frozen Result state PNGs and Recognition Result Hero Media Contract V1 own Result layout and real-photo mapping.
Motion V2 supersedes Motion V1 only for the one-shot RESULT_HIGH Result-entry presentation; all non-conflicting V1 behavior remains active.

keyframes.required: Real fish contour/Halo is the gold-light source; no species title is visible yet.
Intermediate shared-photo handoff into the Result Hero within the existing RESOLVE window; no additional 200 ms delay.
Gold travels from real fish contour toward the species-title area below the photo.
Only soft particles and incomplete glyph mask; full name is not readable early.
Chinese species name becomes legible; validated scientific English name appears directly below when available; one restrained sweep.
Particles/glow disappear and normal static Result typography remains.

species_title.placement: Below the Result Hero photo, in the existing species-title area; never overlay the fish photo.
species_title.secondary_line: Validated scientific English name directly beneath the Chinese name, when available in canonical species metadata.
species_title.geometry_rule: Do not move Hero, metadata, story, or CTAs; text-fit changes must be revalidated against the frozen Result layout.

fallback.when_bbox_or_subject_mapping_untrusted: Opacity-only title resolution; do not invent a particle origin or destination.
fallback.reduce_motion: Remove particle/transfer travel and title sweep; retain restrained opacity-only resolution and immediate readability.
fallback.low_performance: Reduce particles to 0–6 and reduce blur/overdraw without changing result state or actions.
